name: ecommerce-checkout-cart
description: Use when the user asks about a shopping cart, checkout flow, cart abandonment, guest checkout, order state machine, coupon or discount engine, tax calculation or shipping rates. Produces cart, checkout and order designs with conversion fixes. Not for payment gateway integration (use ecommerce-payment-processing) or headless storefronts (use headless-ecommerce).
